# Course audit
```{r}
# Scup School project audit ------------------------------------------------
#
#The audit should answer four questions:
#
#  1. Does the manifest match the filesystem?
#  2. Do page metadata and generated structures match the manifest?
#  3. Are internal links valid?
#  4. How much placeholder content remains?
#
#
# Read-only validation.
# Does not modify project files.
#
# Usage:
#
# source("dev/audit-project.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
# audit_project()
#
# After a Quarto render:
#
# audit_project(check_rendered = TRUE)

source(
  "dev/audit-project.R",
  encoding = "UTF-8"
)

audit_project(
  check_rendered = TRUE
)

```


# manifest update after module 2
```{r}
manifest_path <- "dev/course-manifest.csv"

manifest <- read.csv(
  manifest_path,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Safety checks -------------------------------------------------------------

module_2 <- manifest$module_number == 2

stopifnot(sum(module_2) == 11)

expected_ids <- sprintf(
  "m02-p%02d",
  0:10
)

stopifnot(
  setequal(
    manifest$page_id[module_2],
    expected_ids
  )
)

stopifnot(
  sum(manifest$page_id == "m02-p09") == 1
)


# Module 2 is now integrated ------------------------------------------------

manifest$content_status[module_2] <- "ready"

manifest$page_title[
  manifest$page_id == "m02-p09"
] <- "2. meeting – Problémák közös feltérképezése"


# Save ----------------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  manifest,
  manifest_path,
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  na = ""
)


# Show exactly what Module 2 now says ---------------------------------------

manifest[
  module_2,
  c(
    "page_order",
    "page_id",
    "page_type",
    "page_title",
    "content_status"
  )
]
```
